commits.message:
test(colour): a cell moves at a turn only where the cell across it is drawn like it (candybar-joiners-e5r4.5x1)

The turn property and the preview test held that a cell leaves its dealt tone only beside a turn, so a rule that moved cells at every turn passed them. Both now hold that a moved cell was dealt the colour of the cell across the turn, as dealt or as it stands. The preview's docs say it samples the decorations a closed cell wears, not every one it can.

docs(colour): the preview's meeting swatch can stand in for a window tone, and why the cell after a turn moves first (candybar-joiners-e5r4.5x1)

vocabularyOf and the preview header said every tone of each role's window is sampled; where the swatch at the meeting moves and its role has no other swatch in the tone it was dealt, the sample does not show that tone. The hue-turn rule now states why the cell after the turn moves first and what that means for a keystone at either end of a line. The turn property rounds each entry once per palette and depth.

test(colour): the closing sweep holds under every shipped variation, and nightly under every trial tuning (candybar-joiners-e5r4.5x1)

The sweep moves into a helper so the suite sweeps the four variations
on the dial and the nightly audits sweep the twelve trial tunings
through the same reader. The three rigs are shared across variations,
and the press exemption is computed under the variation swept.

fix(colour): the cells either side of a hue turn draw as two colours at every depth (candybar-joiners-e5r4.5x1)

A dial window keeps one hue's tones apart and the distribution keeps
neighbours of one hue on different tones, but where a row turns hue
(alt every three cells, either side of a keystone) each cell takes a
tone from its own hue's window, and at 256 colours and ansi two hues'
rungs often round onto one colour.

A line of cells is now read as a whole: where the cells either side of
a turn are drawn alike, by identity after rounding, the cell after the
turn takes the first tone of its window drawn as neither neighbour,
else the nearest rung of its ladder through the one widening; where it
has none, the cell before the turn does; where neither has one, the
joiner's lift draws the seam. Each line is memoised by its address, so
a cell's entry is a lookup, and the theme preview's role groups meet
by the same rule.

The unit property holds it over every variation, dial position,
bundled theme and depth, rows to 16. Policy item 4 in the joiners
proposal.

fix(test): the build-currency e2e waits on the daemon's own signal, so a loaded runner cannot fail it (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv) (#502)

* fix(test): a click answered TIMEOUT takes its outcome from the daemon's click event, and is never sent twice (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)

* fix(test): a failure jest would print blank names its message and the file it landed in (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)

* fix(test): a log read judges only whole lines, the reporter pairs each failure with its own block, and the click stand-in leaves no timer behind (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)

* fix(test): the log line is spelled once, and a timed-out click's event waits on the click's reply budget (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
